instruction.name: vreplve.w
instruction.description: Repeat the element in lane `idx` (index modulo 4) of `a` to fill whole vector.

latencies.notes: Vector element gather from vj: the destination register feeds itself, so a plain chain measures the 1-cycle latency of the lane select.

experiments.name: gather index to result
experiments.init: addi.d $r20, $sp, -2048; li.d $r22, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r22; st.d $r20, $r20, 0; addi.d $r4, $r20, 0; li.d $r21, 0; li.d $r5, 1; vreplgr2vr.w $vr1, $r5
experiments.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 4000 --unroll2 8000 --iters 50 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -2048; li.d $r22, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r22; st.d $r20, $r20, 0; addi.d $r4, $r20, 0; li.d $r21, 0; li.d $r5, 1; vreplgr2vr.w $vr1, $r5' --asm 'vreplve.w $vr0, $vr1, $r4; vpickve2gr.w $r4, $vr0, 0'

latencies.notes: Index operand path: the index is carried through the gathered element and the pick (3 cycles), so the measured 6 cycles leave 3 for the gather itself.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vreplve.w $vr0, $vr8, $r4; vreplve.w $vr1, $vr9, $r5; vreplve.w $vr2, $vr10, $r6; vreplve.w $vr3, $vr11, $r7; vreplve.w $vr4, $vr12, $r8; vreplve.w $vr5, $vr13, $r9; vreplve.w $vr6, $vr14, $r10; vreplve.w $vr7, $vr15, $r11
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4; li.d $r4, 0; li.d $r5, 0; li.d $r6, 0; li.d $r7, 0; li.d $r8, 0; li.d $r9, 0; li.d $r10, 0; li.d $r11, 0
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --counter 0xfb --init 'li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4; li.d $r4, 0; li.d $r5, 0; li.d $r6, 0; li.d $r7, 0; li.d $r8, 0; li.d $r9, 0; li.d $r10, 0; li.d $r11, 0' --asm 'vreplve.w $vr0, $vr8, $r4; vreplve.w $vr1, $vr9, $r5; vreplve.w $vr2, $vr10, $r6; vreplve.w $vr3, $vr11, $r7; vreplve.w $vr4, $vr12, $r8; vreplve.w $vr5, $vr13, $r9; vreplve.w $vr6, $vr14, $r10; vreplve.w $vr7, $vr15, $r11'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 8.01 cycles. Counter 0xfb normalised per instruction. The measured CPI 1.0012 is the nominal 1 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: Vector insert/extract/replication instruction. Throughput uses 8 independent lanes.
